errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly maps every single category to its corresponding percentage. The correct mappings, based on the legend and the chart, are: 体育 (Sports) 4%, 社会 (Social) 20%, 榜样 (Role model) 19%, 政治 (Politics) 6%, 文化 (Culture) 14%, 经济 (Economy) 2%, 科学 (Science) 21%, and 环境保护 (Environmental protection) 14%.

errors.text_span: 并且从视觉上看，切片似乎按照大小从大到小排列
errors.evidence: The description claims that the slices appear to be arranged by size, but this is visually false. For example, the largest slice (科学, 21%) is adjacent to one of the smallest (经济, 2%), and another small slice (体育, 4%) is next to the second-largest slice (社会, 20%). The slices are not sorted.
